title: GOOG, MSFT, AMZN, NVDA – INVESTING RISK AND REWARD!!!
summary: All three available English caption chunks were reviewed as untrusted lead material. The speaker argues that AI infrastructure spending, customer concentration, financing and future depreciation create risk for large technology issuers. Existing registered primary evidence already records the relevant capex, cash-conversion, commitment and valuation risks; unsupported figures and predictions were not adopted.
